description_en: You can call the SetDcdnDomainSMCertificate operation to configure an SM certificate for a specific accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用SetDcdnDomainSMCertificate设置指定域名下是否启用国密证书功能
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn set-dcdn-domain-sm-certificate --domain-name example.com --cert-identifier 123-cn-hangzhou --ssl-protocol on --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDcdnDomainSMCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure the SM certificate.

The domain name must use HTTPS acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
指定国密证书所属的加速域名。

加速域名需属于HTTPS加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The certificate ID followed by "-cn-hangzhou". For example, if the certificate ID is \`123\`, the value of CertIdentifier is \`123-cn-hangzhou\`
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the SM certificate.

on: enable.
off: disable
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

on：启用。
off：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol
